lines.text: A new message. Now who could that be?

Good morning ah - Mr. Le Boo! I’ve just moved into the house next door, and - well big fan of the show BooMax great stuff! Anyways, I was just looking at the property line, and haha I think your fence is a couple feet into my yard…

I could be wrong of course. I’m not accusing you of anything. The last thing I want is a diss track out there about me, but - well - I came across a recording of you basically saying you knew it was going into my yard…
just call me back when you have a chance. Thanks… and I’m looking forward to this morning's MinnHax stream. Keep up the great work!
Nice guy! I should offer to pay for the whole fence!
First though, let’s get this stream started.
